message: You know that one friend who goes a bit overboard when a storm is brewing? Well, I have to admit, I can sometimes be that friend. 🌩️ But I've found that staying prepared can really help calm those nerves. There's a great resource out there that covers how to handle the heat during those stormy days. It’s nice to know what to do ahead of time, so we can all just sip our lemonade and enjoy the storm from the porch. What’s your favorite way to stay cool when things heat up?
